answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The vertex of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. Work waits on the onyx until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zephyr of the next round.
